sleeves.oi: fixed four-gate OI divergence pullback, non-overlapping 8h longs

design.weight_meaning: macro weight; OI weight is one minus macro weight
design.execution: five-minute target fractions; same-symbol signed positions net before cost and risk
design.risk: weighted sleeves sum to one and absolute net exposure is capped at 1x
design.selection: none; report every predeclared weight and do not name an optimized winner
design.status: descriptive exposed-period portfolio audit; no live authorization
design.correction: native event rebalancing: macro hourly updates; OI entries/exits only
design.unchanged: sources, signals, targets, weights, netting, cost rates, funding and price bars
